in_marathi.name: Guddi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Little One, Beloved
in_marathi.long_meaning: Guddi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'guddha' which means 'little one' or 'beloved'. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Guddu is considered the deity of childhood and is often depicted as a playful and mischievous goddess. The name is also found in Marathi literature as a term of endearment.
